Commentary.Commentary: Jeetan Patel had a good game although he leaked runs in his final spell while Santner was quite tidy too. The others leaked runs with their famed pace pair of Southee and Boult conceding a combined tally of 140 runs off their 20 overs. New Zealand did miss a couple of chances too although the fielding was generally good. A total of 230-240 would have been competitive and NZ looked like they could restrict SA inside it before the slog overs mayhem. Advantage Proteas at the break. Join us in a while for the chase.

Excellent finish from the Proteas, 100 came off the last 8 overs and that onslaught has given them a formidable total. After opting to bat, they lost de Kock for a duck but du Plessis and Amla set a platform with steady knocks although neither managed to carry on for a bigger one. The sluggish surface meant that scoring was difficult but de Villiers produced a gem, well supported by a blistering cameo from Parnell to push the total well above par.

OUT! Yorker outside off, dug out through cover-point for a single. Parnell sacrifices himself as they look to steal the second run which was never there. It's the last ball of the innings and so worth the risk. Neesham fires the throw at the keeper's end and Ronchi has all the time in the world to dislodge the bails with Parnell not in the frame. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 279-8.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Fuller and on the stumps, Parnell works it away on the leg side for a single.
Very full and outside off, dug out to the off side for a single.

SIX! SMOKED! Southee misses the yorker and it is in the slot for de Villiers who clobbers it high over long off for a biggie. Brilliant finish this is for the Proteas. They seem to have batted NZ out of the game considering this pitch.
Full and wide outside off, creamed through the covers. They scamper back for the second run.
AB goes over the covers but there is protection in the deep. Just a single.
Full and outside off, AB tries another reverse sweep but misses.

FOUR! OHH, AB! How does he do these? Slower ball on a length around off, AB goes across and reverse laps it over the keeper for a boundary. He had so much time, it was a slower ball but still the way he executed the shot was tremendous. Brings up the 50-run stand and it's come off just 18 balls. Game changing stuff.
Speared way outside off, that's a big wide.
Fuller on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! BIGGIE! Parnell is partying out there. Fuller around off, he clubs it over mid-wicket. For a moment it seemed like it had more height than distance but the small ground dimensions ensured a biggie.
FOUR! Thumped! Full toss and Parnell backs away a bit to smack it down the ground to the long on fence. Clean striking and this is proving to be a lovely cameo from Wayne so far.
Slips it down the leg side, wide to start the over.
TRENT BOULT is back on.
In the air...just safe! Fuller around off, Parnell steps out to play the big shot but skews it high over backward point. Just lands safe in the deep as the batsmen get a single.
Slower ball down the leg side, Parnell misses the paddle. Wide called.

SIX! What a shot! Parnell joins in the fun. Slog overs are hurting NZ very badly. Fuller around off, Parnell steps out to that one and lofts it dead straight down the ground. Bisects long on and long off exactly for a maximum.
Fuller around off, AB shuffles across and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! KABOOM! AB has shifted into top gear now. Picks the slower ball early and propels it over deep mid-wicket for a soaring maximum. Great bat swing on the stroke.
Good length outside off, Parnell taps it to point for a run.
52nd ODI fifty for de Villiers.
Very full on off, jammed towards square leg for a single. Another milestone for the great man.
TIM SOUTHEE is back on.
Great running. Fuller on off, Parnell nudges it through mid-wicket. They scamper back for the second run.
Fuller on the stumps, worked on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Fired well down the leg side, left alone and it's a wide.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! BLEEDING RUNS NOW! The Kiwis are letting it slip. Slightly short outside off, Parnell gets back and guides it through point to find the fence.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Finesse from AB! Goes for the reverse sweep to the full toss and makes fine connection through point. Boult makes a superb dive in the deep but couldn't prevent the fence.
JEETAN PATEL is back.
On middle and leg, AB works it past mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
WAYNE PARNELL is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Very full on middle, Morris looks to swing across the line but misses and finds the timber disturbed. It was there to be hit but he chose the wrong option. Straight down the ground would have been ideal.
FOUR! HEAVED AWAY! Fuller on middle and leg, Morris clears his front leg and clubs it over mid-wicket to find the boundary. Clean striking this.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Fuller ball on off, Morris lofts it cleanly down the ground. Mid on was up in the circle and so there will always be full value for shots if it clears the infield.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
TRENT BOULT is back on.

FOUR! Hammered! This is getting very predictable from Southee. Tries another slower ball on back of a length, Morris sits deep in the crease and mauls the pull over mid-wicket to find the fence. Expensive over and the SA innings gaining momentum.
Shortish again but this time AB cannot capitalize. Pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Crashed! AB is now on the move. Southee bangs it short and de Villiers sits up to pull it over short mid-wicket. Cleared the infield easily and long on had too much ground to cover as the ball races to the fence. 200 up for SA.
Slower ball on the shorter side, Morris plays a half-pull to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, steps out and pats it back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, AB gets across the stumps and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
TIM SOUTHEE comes back on.
Spears it very wide outside off, AB reaches it and punches it to sweeper cover for a single to keep strike.
Full and outside off, AB drives it towards short cover.
Flatter on middle, stays back and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off, pushed through mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! THAT'S HUGE! AB tees off and clears the ropes with ease. Slightly short from Santner and de Villiers rocks back quickly to launch the pull way over deep mid-wicket. SA need him to bat through to reach a competitive total.
Fuller on off, squeezed towards square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Morris drives it to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and defends well.
Flatter on middle and leg, whipped away on the leg side for a single.
Fuller outside off, reaches out and drives it down to long on for a single.
Around the wicket and fuller outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
FOUR! SMART BATTING! Morris brings out the reverse sweep and makes good contact. Gets it through point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, makes room and drives but straight to extra cover.
Flighted on middle, Morris thumps it down to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, reaches out and blocks well.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Floated outside off, AB steers it towards the point fielder.
MITCHELL SANTNER comes back on.
Flighted on middle, nudged with the spin to the right of the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Speared in on middle and leg, whipped past mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on off, stays back and punches it towards short mid-wicket.
Drifting in from outside off, Morris goes for the sweep but is hit on the back leg. Impact just outside the line.
Flatter ball outside off, stays back and punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Full and outside off, driven with the spin down to long on for a single.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle.
Back of a length on off, stays back and shovels it to short mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, crisply driven by AB towards extra cover.
Good length on middle and leg, worked away down to fine leg for a single.
Beaten! Neesham has been good with his leg cutters today. Morris pushes tamely at one of those and is beaten comprehensively.
Good length outside off, steered towards point.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
JIMMY NEESHAM is back.
Flatter outside off, AB camps back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Drifting in on the stumps, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Fuller on off, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Floated around off, swept towards backward square leg where Taylor makes a good stop. Single taken.
Fuller on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Gets it away fine! Floated around leg stump, spins further down the leg side as AB gets a faint tickle past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Shortish outside off, Morris cuts towards point.
Good length closer to off, Morris defends it solidly from the crease.
Too straight from Boult and AB works it away on the leg side for a single.
Fuller on the pads, goes across to flick but is struck on the pads.
Full and outside off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a brace.
Fuller outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Good length around off, defended well from the crease.
CHRIS MORRIS is the new man in.

OUT! MIX UP AND GONE! Waste of a wicket. Pretorius works it straight to square leg and wants a single. Slight stutter but they decide to go through with the single. Dwaine was never going to make it as Taylor fires the throw at the bowler's end. Patel does the rest and Pretorius is well short.
Fuller on off, pushed gently towards mid on.
FOUR! Smacked! A bit short outside off, stays back and flashes the square cut. Made good contact and the ball races to the fence.
Floated around off, blocked well from the crease.
Full and outside off, pushed towards the covers.
JEETAN PATEL is back.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it past mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Slower bouncer on off, AB somehow gets out of the way and controls the pull for a single.
Shortish outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a run.

Fuller on middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket. AB wanted two as soon as he hit it but Williamson sprinted across from mid on to make a sliding stop that prevented the second run. Great fielding.
Full and around off, Pretorius gets a leading edge through cover for a single.
Beaten! Another lovely leg cutter and this time it's AB who fails to get bat on ball. This is a fairly good spell from Neesham.
Football skills from AB! Back of a length around off, he looks to block but gets a bottom edge on it. Reacts instantly and kicks the ball away as it was nearing the sticks.
Good length outside off, sits back and steers it down to third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, cut away hard but straight to the man at point.
Beautiful bowling! Faster leg cutter around off, Dwaine pushes at it and is lucky not to get an edge on it.
Fuller ball outside off, de Villiers drives it through the covers for a single.
Good length outside off, Pretorius stays in the crease and defends towards point.
Slower ball from around the wicket, angling in, Dwaine pushes at it but gets the edge that rolls to gully on the bounce.
Back of a length outside off, climbs on to AB who gets it to third man off the bottom half of the blade. Single taken.
Back of a length outside off, forced off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Lovely bowling! Slants it full and across the right-hander, Pretorius is beaten on the lazy drive.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot to the off side.
TRENT BOULT is back.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and pushes it down the track.
Length ball outsideo ff, Pretorius taps it to point for a single.
Good length outside off, steered towards backward point.
Length ball outside off, angling in, Pretorius gets a faint inside edge on to the pads as he looks to block.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards point.
Back of a length outside off, AB is surprised by the bounce and somehow dabs it down to third man for a single.
DWAINE PRETORIUS is the new batsman.
Drinks break.

OUT! Miller is gone cheaply! South Africa's innings going off track. Flighted full ball on middle, Miller brings out his slog sweep but fails to middle it well. It flies off the toe part of the bat and Brownlie in the deep mid-wicket region takes a well-judged low catch. Miller's poor form since returning from a finger injury continues.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it straight to square leg.
Flighted on off, defended off the front foot to point.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
DAVID MILLER is in next.

OUT! Soft dismissal and it's a timely wicket for New Zealand. Neesham angles in a length ball on middle, holding up a bit onto the batsman, du Plessis is early into the shot and ends up giving a catching practice to Santner at short mid-wicket. End of a good knock by Faf but on this pitch after getting his eyes in, he should have batted through. Not going to be easy for the new batsman walking in to adjust to the pace.
Uses the pace of the bowler and guides it to third man for one.
Wide called for height! Short ball going down the leg side, AB allows it through to the keeper.
Full on this occasion, it's driven through covers for another single.
Short and outside off, stroked from the back foot to sweeper cover for one.
Good length ball on off, it's punched through covers for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Faf plays from the crease and taps it down to backward point.
JIMMY NEESHAM is back into the attack.
Loopy full ball on middle, AB gets forward in defense.
Strides forward and drives it with the spin through covers for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, driven firmly to covers where Broom dived to make a good stop.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it to mid off.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Southee ups his pace and digs in a short ball on off, de Villiers is beaten for pace as he tries to pull and gets it away off the inner half of his blade.
Wind has picked up and slowly dark clouds are building over the stadium.
Angles in a short ball on off, a mistimed pull by Faf this time but it has gone through the gap at mid-wicket. A single to rotate the strike.
Third dot ball in a row. Pressure building on Faf. On a length and outside off, Faf tries to run it down to third man but mistimes his shot towards point.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. No run.
Fuller and on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Slower length ball outside off, it's helped down to third man for a single.
Once again stays back, covers the line and defends it back. Tidy over, a couple of runs off it!
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Short and cut through cover-point for a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
MIX-UP! Full floated on off, du Plessis pushes it to covers and sets off for a single. AB de Villiers immediately sends him back and a more powerful throw by Guptill would have ended Faf's stay.
Loopy full ball on off, Faf gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
MITCHELL SANTNER is back on.
Angles in a full ball outside off, de Villiers gets forward and across to defend it in front of his front pad.
AB DE VILLIERS arrives.

OUT! This time Duminy has dragged it on! Southee persists with his line around off, angling in a length ball and not giving enough room for the cut shot. Duminy, however, still wants to manufacture a square cut and ends up inside edging it onto the stumps. He survived on the second ball of this over but not this time. A 62-run stand has been broken and Duminy falls once again after getting a start.
Too full in length on middle, Faf pushes it down to long on for a single.
Shortish and outside off, JP forces it in front of the point fielder and scampers across for a sharp single.
Nearly drags it on! Southee angles in a length ball outside off, a wobbled seam delivery, Duminy tries to cut it through the line but gets a bottom edge. It goes on one bounce to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, from around the wicket, JP plays from the crease to short third man. Straight to the fielder and it's a dot ball.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Beaten! Smart ploy from Jimmy. Bowls a cutter outside off, Duminy tries to play the late cut but is beaten.
Wicketkeeper comes up to the stumps.
Width on offer outside off, du Plessis guides it down to third man for an easy run.
Shortish on leg, Duminy walks towards the line of the delivery, makes room and glides it down to third man for a single.
Play and a miss! A touch short again, angling away from the left-hander outside off, Duminy tries to play the square cut but misses.
Starts with a back of a length ball on off, it's punched off the back foot by du Plessis to sweeper cover for a single.
JIMMY NEESHAM is introduced into the attack.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Faf turns it to the left side of the square leg umpire and picks up a single.
Straighter in line, Duminy tickles it off his pads to fine leg for a run.
A short third man comes into place.
Drops it full and outside off, Faf reaches out for it and lofts it over covers for a single.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Faf pushes it off the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short of a length ball outside off, slower in pace again, du Plessis gives the charge and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller and slower on off, du Plessis plays it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
25th ODI fifty for Faf du Plessis.

FOUR! Excellent shot by Faf. A full length ball is angled into him, he knows that mid on is up inside the circle and hence plays a measured chip shot in the air over the fielder. Nice timing and it races through. Lovely knock by him and he would like to convert it.
Angles in a back of a length ball on off, du Plessis punches it from the back foot to short cover.
Sharp delivery. Boult steams in from around the wicket and spears in a full ball on middle, Faf is completely cramped for room and ends up getting and inside edge on his back pad. Terrific stuff.
Length ball angling down the leg side, Duminy helps it down to fine leg for a single.
Changes his angle again for the southpaw, comes from around the wicket and angles in a slower length ball on off, Duminy runs it down to third man for a single.
Off cutter on off, Faf picks it early and nudges it behind square leg for a single.
Short ball banged into the batsman, Duminy gets on top of the bounce and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a single. Good stop in the deep.
Fullish and angling in, another cutter, Duminy defends it from the crease to point.
On a length and outside off, from around the wicket, Duminy shoulders arms.
Starts his new spell with an off cutter around off, du Plessis gets across a bit and defends it closer to his pads. The ball rolls in the gap at square leg and they cross for a single.
TIM SOUTHEE is back on as well.
Angles across a length ball on off, from over the wicket this time, du Plessis taps it down to covers and pinches a single.
Full and angling into the batsman from around the wicket, Faf sticks back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
A little bit of width on offer outside off, JP uses the pace of the bowler and deflects it towards third man for a single.
Fullish and angling into the batsman, Duminy gets forward with a straight bat and defends it back.
Du Plessis has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.

Good start to the spell. Lands it on a length around off and gets it to curve back in off the seam, Duminy tries to play with an angled bat towards third man but it takes the inside edge. Goes through his legs behind square leg for a single.
TRENT BOULT is back into the attack.
Floated one on off, defended off the front foot. 8 off the over, a decent partnership is once again developing for the visiting team.

FOUR! Superb shot! Loopy delivery, full and wide outside off, du Plessis takes a big stride forward and drives it crisply past the diving mid off fielder for a boundary. The placement was pretty precise.
Flatter and on middle, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on off, du Plessis plays with the spin and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Eases a full ball through mid off for a run.
Full toss, du Plessis drives it down the ground to long on for one.
Another false shot! Tossed up ball on off, Duminy tries playing the paddle scoop but fails to middle it. It pops out but dies down quickly in front of him. Could have gone anywhere.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it with the spin through covers for one.
Tossed up ball on off, Faf lofts it over the cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tickles it through the gap at mid-wicket and gets off strike.

Dropped by Guptill! Oh dear, that should have been taken. Flighted ball on off, spinning back in a touch, Duminy gets back and mistimes his punch in the air towards short mid-wicket. Guptill dives to his right but fails to hold on to the one-handed catch. He is frustrated with himself as he sets high standards in the field. A reprieve for JP!
Loopy and full outside off, Duminy eases his drive through mid off and takes another run.
Gets forward to a full ball and forces it past the diving bowler to long on. A single added to the total.
Serves a full toss on middle, Duminy flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Flighted on middle, tucked to the right side of the mid-wicket fielder for a quick single.
Slower ball but it's too short around off, JP pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler.
Slows this one in the air and lands it full on middle, du Plessis draws forward and brings his bat ahead of front pad in defense. Tight over by Mitch!
Pitches it full and on off, Faf drives off the front foot but Santner moves to his left to stop the ball.
Flights in the air and serves it full outside off, du Plessis gets forward in defense.

False shot and JP's heart would have been in his mouth. He goes down on one knee for a slog sweep but it takes the top edge and balloons towards fine leg. Falls safely in front of the fielder in the deep and they cross.
Tossed up and on middle, it's nudged behind square leg for an easy run.
Flighted ball on middle, Duminy gets down on one knee and sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Drinks break....Steady start for the Proteas on a two-paced surface that is aiding spin. 250 will be more than handy and the Kiwis will have to make further inroads quickly.
Full and on the pads, clipped towards the leg side.
Fuller outside off, JP bunts it down to long off for a single.
Drifting in from around off, pushed through mid on for a single.
Full and on middle,  worked away through the on side for a run.
Fuller on the pads, clipped down the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Williamson doesn't seem amused with the end result. This was lovely fuller ball outside off, slid on with the angle as Faf went for the drive. Ronchi collected it and the appeal for caught behind was instantaneous from Kane. The umpire wasn't interested and NZ went for the review. Nothing on Hot Spot although there was a very slight spike on the Snicko. Probably too mild and the third umpire feels that the on-field call must stay.
NZ have taken a review for caught behind against Faf.
KANE WILLIAMSON comes on to bowl.
Floated outside off, reaches out to that one and defends solidly.
Full and outside off, leans forward and blocks it well.
Fuller outside off, Faf reaches out and pumps it to long off for a single.
Flatter on middle, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, JP hangs back and blocks it firmly.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped away through the leg side for a single.
That was close! Drifting in from outside off, Duminy looks to push but gets an inside edge that just misses the leg stump as the ball rolls to short fine leg.
Slider outside off, sits back and defends it firmly to cover.
Beaten! Good stuff from Patel. Quicker ball outside off, the ball hisses away past the outside edge as JP looks to block.
Fuller on middle and leg, swept away on the leg side for a single.
Beaten! Drifting in from outside off, turns away after pitching to beat the outside edge.
Flighted around off, defended well from the crease.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller on middle and leg, JP goes across to that one and sweeps it beautifully through backward square leg for a boundary.
Full and on the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Fuller around off, Faf pushes it gently towards cover. Muted appeal for lbw from Santner. Was it pad first? Impact was marginally anyway.
Flatter outside off, JP sits back and steers it to short third man for a single.
Fired in on leg stump, Faf clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
MITCHELL SANTNER is back on.
Fuller on off, JP pushes it back to the bowler.
JP DUMINY is the new man in. That's a surprise from the SA camp. Maybe AB feels that it is important to finish well on a pitch like this and wants to bat the final part as much as possible.

OUT! FREAKY DISMISSAL! Amla will be kicking himself when he sees the replays of this one. Outside off, spinning in a touch, Amla goes well across for the premeditated paddle. He had got into a tangle off the first ball of the over but this time actually made decent contact. However, length did him in as it wasn't that full and the ball cannons on to the sticks. Awkward dismissal in the end but the Kiwis won't mind it. Amla was looking in supreme touch until this.
Fuller outside off, reaches out to that one and blocks well.
Floated on off, du Plessis works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Almost got into a tangle. Floated around leg stump, Amla went across early and then adjusted to paddle it down to fine leg for a single.
On middle and leg, Amla works it past mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Vintage Amla stroke! Length ball angled into the body, he stays tall and whips it through mid-wicket. Sublime timing and placement as the ball races across the outfield to the ropes.
Full on off, Amla closes the bat face too early and gets a leading edge that bobbles towards point.
Good length closer to off, Amla defends it well from the crease.
Fuller on the stumps, dug out down to long on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, cut away to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on off, Faf whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, clipped on the leg side for a single.
Another neat paddle from Faf towards fine leg. Boult puts in a superb dive again to keep the batsmen down to two. Good cricket all round.
Floated around off, nicely blocked from the crease.
Big shout but the impact saves Faf. Faf goes for the big sweep but the ball spins in a touch to rap him on the front pad.
Floated on middle, premediated paddle from du Plessis and he takes it on the full. Good running gets them a brace as the ball goes towards fine leg. Fine stop from Boult near the ropes.
JEETAN PATEL is back on.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Length ball outside off, Amla guides it towards the point region.
Fuller and outside off, Amla reaches out and defends solidly.
Good length closer to off, nicely blocked from the crease.
50-run stand between Amla and du Plessis.
Fuller outside off, Amla eases it sweetly through the covers. Won't make the fence but they will take a brace. Valuable partnership this after the early loss of de Kock.
Pitched up on the stumps, Amla squeezes it out off the inside half towards the leg side.
Fuller on middle and off, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
COLIN DE GRANDHOMME comes on to bowl. Strangely just the 3 overs of spin so far despite the fact that they were getting sharp turn right from the start.
Full and outside off, another slower ball and Amla just about digs it out on to the track.
Length ball on off, stays back and pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length on middle, gets back and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and steers it to point.
FOUR! SHOT! Back of a length outside off, Faf stands tall and punches it sweetly square of the wicket. The backward point fielder put in a dive but it went past him to the fence.
Full and outside off, 112.6 kph, Faf is happy blocking it off the front foot to cover.
Length ball outside off, Amla shoulders arms to that one.
FOUR! Slapped! Boult errs on the shorter side and Amla stays back to power the cut through point. That rocketed to the fence in no time. Hashim is looking in good touch at the moment.
SIX! WHACK! Slower ball from Boult but Amla has picked it early. Lifts it over the covers and has made enough connection to sent it over the ropes as well. Top stroke!
Good length outside off, Amla steers it towards point.
FOUR! Classy from Amla. This is on middle and leg, he just gets across and tickles it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Beautiful touch play from the opener.
Good length closer to off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Length ball outside off, stays back and pats it back to the bowler.
Good length closer to off, blocked firmly from the crease.

Ouch! That has stung du Plessis. It was a slower ball at 115 kph and gripped a bit after pitching. Extra bounce after pitching and Faf is struck on the right glove. He immediately drops his bottom hand in pain.
Good length angled in on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Good length outside off, Faf stays back and steers it to short third man. Brisk run taken.
Fuller on off, jammed towards the mid on region by du Plessis.
Boult comes around the wicket and looks to angle it in from outside off, another leave from Amla.
Slanted across the right-hander on a length. Amla lets it pass.
FOUR! Nice shot! Boult tests the midpoint of the track but Amla is equal to the task with a nice pull past a diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Good length outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
Fuller on off, Faf leans forward and drives it firmly towards mid on.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Amla. This is speared down the leg side and all he had to do was to get some bat on it. Deflects it neatly down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, plays late this time and steers it towards third man for a single.
Good length outside off, Faf plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Speared down the leg side, Faf misses the flick and that's a wide.
Length ball on middle and leg, Faf works it through square leg and they hare back for the second.
Nice shot but cannot split the gap. Back of a length outside off, crunched off the back foot but straight to cover.
Good length on middle and leg, blocked solidly to the leg side.
TIM SOUTHEE comes into the attack. Williamson is ringing in the changes.
Fuller but down the leg side, Amla misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads. Ronchi dives to his left to collect it well.

Is that close? No, just a bit high. Amla misjudged a late indipper and decided to let it pass. The ball brushed the thigh pad on its way to the keeper. Just a bit too high and the lbw appeal is rightly turned down.
Good length on middle, another solid defensive stroke from Amla down the track.
Length ball on middle and leg, Amla blocks it well to the leg side.
Good length angled away from around off, defended well from the crease.
Fuller outside off, crisply driven to mid off. Looked a certain boundary but Williamson puts in a dive to keep the batsmen down to just a single. Superb stuff.
TRENT BOULT comes on to bowl.
Fuller on off, leans into it and blocks solidly on to the track.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Too short and outside off, easy for Amla who rocks back and cuts it through backward point to find the ropes. Cannot afford to give freebies on such a surface.
Wide! Fired down the leg side, lot of spin but erratic line. Wide called.
Speared on the pads, Faf nudges it down the leg side for a run.
Flatter on the pads, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, gets across and sweeps but it's well stopped by Santner with a dive at short fine leg. Single taken.
Fuller outside off, Faf leans forward and blocks well.
Floated on a length around off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Flighted outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Floated outside off, reaches out and blocks it well.
Looped up outside off, tapped through cover for a single.
A bit short outside off, allows Faf to punch it off the back foot past cover for a single.
Ripper! Turn and bounce, we are only in the second over of the game! Ominous signs ahead for batsmen on this pitch. Flatter ball outside off, Faf pushes at it as the ball spins past the outside edge.
MITCHELL SANTNER to take the other new ball. Not sure if we are in NZ or in the sub-continent.
Floated on middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot.
Huge appeal for lbw but the impact saved Faf. Fuller and outside off, he looks to push at it but is struck on the front pad.
FAF DU PLESSIS is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! Perfect start for the Kiwis and the move to start with Patel has worked wonders. Loopy off break on a length outside off, turns away late after pitching. De Kock looks to push at it and then decides to make a leave. Too late though and he gets a feather that is easily pouched by Ronchi. A golden duck for Quinton.
Drifting in on middle and leg, rocks back and works it with the turn through square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, Amla gets back and clips it towards short fine leg. Already spin on offer for the off spinner.

The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. The customary opening pair for South Africa, HASHIM AMLA and QUINTON DE KOCK. Surprising move from Kane Williamson as it shall be JEETAN PATEL to start proceedings.

TEAM CHANGES - South Africa have made just a solitary change with CHRIS MORRIS coming in for Andile Phehlukwayo. The Kiwis have made three changes after the battering in the previous game. MARTIN GUPTILL returns, while LUKE RONCHI and JEETAN PATEL also come in. Tom Latham, Neil Broom and Lockie Ferguson are the ones missing out for the hosts.
TOSS - SOUTH AFRICA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Hello and a warm welcome to the fourth ODI between New Zealand and South Africa in Hamilton. The Proteas played their near best in the last game and will want to wrap up the series here itself. The Kiwis know that it's do-or-die time and will have to raise their game to stay alive in the series. Martin Guptill's return will surely help boost their morale. With a two-paced surface expected, we could be in for a close game if NZ play to potential. The toss isn't far away.
